description.value: Sporting Life is a mid-to-upscale Canadian sporting goods chain retailer located in the Lougheed Town Centre mall in Burnaby. The brand is known nationally for carrying cycling, running, and outdoor gear alongside premium apparel. A touring cyclist passing through would find it a potential source for cycling accessories, apparel, or gear rather than workshop-style repair services.
